author: reek
body: Creations SPA: account-owned world builder with community gallery and integrated World Forge. Replaces the hand-JS creations.html with pure Codex compiled to JavaScript by the html plug. Auth via AuthClient; dimension data fetched from the bare-metal DB server; NameForge and StoryGraph run client-side for procedural world generation.

author: reek
body: Data model: a creation is (kind, name, data) owned by an account. kind = setting | character | item | world. name = composed from picks or forged from seed. data = joined prompt fragments or formatted world text.

author: reek
body: Each kind has a list of dimension table names. The server serves each table at /api/<table> as a JSON array of [name, prompt-fragment] rows. Adding a new kind or dimension is a data change: add entries here and the UI builds itself.
